values: top performers were models pretrained on whole-human blood and lung datasets brain pretrained model trailed by 8% compared to blood pretrained model despite similar size

values: scgpt outperforms gears and linear regression in predicting unseen perturbation responses across datasets

components.name: method
values: scgpt fine-tuning for cell type annotation | a neural network classifier takes scgpt cell embedding as input and outputs cell type predictions trained with cross-entropy on reference dataset.

components.name: task
values: fine-tuned scgpt for cell type annotation on human pancreas dataset multiple sclerosis ms dataset and tumor-infiltrating myeloid dataset with unseen cancer types.

components.name: dataset
values: cellxgene collection | 33 million human cells normal non-disease

components.name: method
values: scgpt pretraining | generative pretraining using a transformer with masked attention trained on over 33 million cells to jointly optimize cell and gene representations.

components.name: task
values: generative pretraining of scgpt on over 33 million human cells from cellxgene collection comprising 51 organs/tissues and 441 studies.
visualization of pretrained cell embeddings using umap.

components.name: method
values: scgpt fine-tuning for perturbation prediction | fine-tuned on subset of perturbations to predict expression profile given control cell state and perturbed genes tested on unseen perturbations.

components.name: task
values: evaluated using pearson delta and pearson delta on top 20 differentially expressed genes.
fine-tuned scgpt to predict unseen one-gene and two-gene perturbation responses on adamson replogle and norman perturb-seq datasets.
in silico reverse perturbation prediction on a subset of norman dataset.

components.name: method
values: scgpt fine-tuning for integration | self-supervised fine-tuning by learning unified cell representations that recover masked gene expression.

components.name: task
values: fine-tuned scgpt for multi-batch integration on covid-19 18 batches pbmc 10k 2 batches and perirhinal cortex 2 batches datasets.
fine-tuned scgpt for multi-omic integration on 10x multiome pbmc gene expression + chromatin accessibility bmmc gene expression + protein abundance and asap human pbmc mosaic integration datasets.

components.name: task
values: compared pretrained models on whole-human 33m blood 10.3m lung 2.1m brain 13.2m datasets for integration performance on covid-19 dataset.

components.name: method
values: scgpt grn inference | gene embeddings construct similarity network attention maps capture cell-state-specific activation patterns.

components.name: task
values: compared scgpt-extracted gene programs to coexpression networks on immune human dataset.
extracted gene networks from scgpt embeddings and attention maps validated using chip-atlas and reactome pathway enrichment.
